newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka, Valmiera leap on buoyant Latvia bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka, Valmiera leap on buoyant Latvia bourse.

text.p: Leading bank Unibanka leapt and market newcomer Valmiera Glassfibre soared on what was a buoyant Latvian stock market on Monday.
Market turnover was 281,000 lats of which Unibanka accounted for 76,600 lats as it rose to 4.49 lats from 3.91 lats.
The market is expecting this week the release of Unibanka's 1996 earnings and is also looking forward to a key shareholders meeting at the end of March.
Market newcomer Valmiera, quoted on the secondary list, rose to 2.20 lats, well above its nominal starting price of one lat. Turnover was 2,600 lats.
Valmiera is seen as a new, quality stock on the bourse having many customers in the West and a large Western investor in the shape of German Glasseiden Oschatz.
Other official list share Riga Transport Fleet outstripped Unibanka in volume terms with trade of 106,300 lats but was stable at 1.70 lats.
Confectioner Staburadze climbed to 2.80 lats from 2.65 lats and traded a small 10,600 lats of shares.

The secondary list was led by far by Daugavpils Chain, which crept higher to 2.65 lats from 2.61 lats on turnover of 32,400 lats. Kaija also saw buoyant trade of 17,800 lats and rose slightly to 2.25 lats from 2.23 lats.
Other gainers included Ventspils fish cannery, which rose to 2.39 lats from 2.08 lats on turnover of 2,200 lats while Lode Brick rose slightly to 2.15 lats from 2.11 lats on trade of 5,500 lats.
Lode last week announced a 1996 profit of 130,000 lats which came after two years of losses.
Jekabpils Sugar was actively traded on 8,200 lats but rose only slightly to 70 santimes from 80 santimes.
